CONSOLIDATED REGIONAL ARTS COUNCIL
GENERAL OPERATING SUPPORT AGREEMENT — FISCAL YEAR 2027
Document Control No. CRAC-FY27-GOS-0311 | Rev. 3 | Printed 08/12/2026
================================================================================

GENERAL OPERATING SUPPORT AGREEMENT

Grantee: Marrow Street Theater Company
Grantee Address: 411 Marrow Street, Ravensburg, Pennsylvania 17403
Award Number: CRAC-FY27-GOS-0311
Award Amount: Ninety-Five Thousand and 00/100 Dollars ($95,000.00 USD)
Grant Period: September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027
Council Contact: Jerome Nakashima, Grants Manager
Date of Agreement: August 12, 2026

This Agreement is made between the Consolidated Regional Arts Council, a Pennsylvania nonprofit corporation (the "Council"), and Marrow Street Theater Company (the "Grantee"), and sets out the terms on which general operating support is provided for the Grantee's FY2027 season.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SECTION 1. AWARD

1.1 The Council awards the Grantee $95,000.00 as unrestricted general operating support for the Grant Period. Funds may be applied to any ordinary and necessary expense of producing and presenting the Grantee's FY2027 season, including artistic fees, production costs, administrative salaries, marketing, and facility costs.

1.2 Payment will be made in two installments of $47,500.00 each, the first on or about September 30, 2026 and the second on or about March 31, 2027. The second installment is contingent upon receipt of the mid-year report required by Section 3.1.

1.3 Grant funds may not be used for cash reserves, deficit reduction predating September 1, 2026, capital campaigns, endowment, or re-granting.

SECTION 2. PROGRAM COMMITMENTS

2.1 The Grantee shall produce not fewer than four (4) mainstage productions during the Grant Period, with not fewer than 48 total public performances.

2.2 The Grantee shall present not fewer than six (6) student matinee performances and shall provide not fewer than 1,800 complimentary or reduced-price tickets to students and community partners.

2.3 The Grantee shall maintain its pay-what-you-decide performance on the first Thursday of each production run.

SECTION 3. REPORTING

3.1 Mid-Year Report. The Grantee shall submit a mid-year report no later than February 28, 2027, covering September 1, 2026 through January 31, 2027. The mid-year report shall state productions mounted, performance and attendance counts, student matinee counts, and a budget-to-actual statement for the period.

3.2 Final Report. The Grantee shall submit a final report no later than October 30, 2027. The final report shall include full-season attendance figures, a final statement of revenue and expenses for FY2027, the number of complimentary and reduced-price tickets distributed under Section 2.2, and a copy of the Grantee's FY2027 audited or reviewed financial statements if available.

3.3 Board Resolution. The Grantee shall submit a certified copy of the board resolution accepting this award within forty-five (45) days of the date of this Agreement.

3.4 Reports shall be submitted through the Council's grants portal. Late reports may result in ineligibility for FY2028 funding.

SECTION 4. ACKNOWLEDGMENT AND CREDIT

4.1 The Grantee shall include the Council's logo and the credit line "Season support provided by the Consolidated Regional Arts Council" in every playbill, on the Grantee's website, and in season subscription materials produced during the Grant Period.

4.2 The Grantee shall provide the Council with two (2) complimentary tickets to opening night of each mainstage production.

SECTION 5. ACCESSIBILITY

5.1 The Grantee shall comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act and shall provide at least one audio-described performance and one open-captioned performance during the Grant Period.

5.2 The Grantee shall publish its accessibility accommodations on its website and in all ticketing materials and shall designate a staff member as accessibility coordinator.

SECTION 6. INSURANCE AND FACILITIES

6.1 The Grantee shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than $2,000,000 aggregate and shall name the Council as an additional insured for any performance presented in a Council-owned venue.

6.2 The Grantee shall provide a current certificate of insurance to the Council on or before September 15, 2026.

SECTION 7. RECORDS AND ACCESS

7.1 The Grantee shall retain financial and attendance records supporting the reports required by Section 3 for a period of five (5) years after submission of the final report.

7.2 The Council may audit or review the Grantee's records relating to this award upon thirty (30) days written notice.

SECTION 8. NOTIFICATIONS

8.1 The Grantee shall notify the Council in writing within twenty (20) days of any cancellation of a production announced in its FY2027 season, any change in artistic or executive leadership, or any operating deficit exceeding ten percent (10%) of its annual budget.

8.2 The Grantee shall notify the Council immediately of any loss of its 501(c)(3) status or any lapse in its Pennsylvania charitable solicitation registration.

SECTION 9. TERMINATION AND REPAYMENT

9.1 The Council may terminate this Agreement upon thirty (30) days written notice if the Grantee ceases operations, fails to produce at least two mainstage productions, or fails to submit required reports.

9.2 Upon termination, the Grantee shall repay any portion of the award attributable to the period after termination within sixty (60) days.

SECTION 10. GENERAL

10.1 This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement of the parties concerning the FY2027 general operating award and supersedes prior discussions.

10.2 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.

10.3 Neither party may assign this Agreement without the written consent of the other.
